summary: Traffic hulls darker (balance traffic_hull_dark 0.45, placeholder) and five hull kinds (triangle plus square, long rectangle, wide slab, stacked box). Kinds live in the one hull surface; each vertex carries its kind in UV2.x and the vertex shader collapses the kinds a ship does not wear. Kind comes from a seed hash (KIND_TABLE, triangles most common), stable per ship. Draw calls unchanged (8 at most), no new nodes, no per-frame CPU work, buffers untouched. Engine streak unchanged (all tails at z=+0.5). Cargo tint is darkened only half as much as the hull so it stays readable.
